scope_notes: Seeds cover total Europe-Turkey, medals, and orders collection pagination as exposed by current collection pages.
All visible collection pages were processed; sold-out/history product pages were retained and availability is recorded separately.
658 fetched product URL forms collapse to 363 unique product slugs; all collection-path URL variants and cache paths remain in each candidate record.
Modern Turkey, Ottoman, and ambiguous products are separated provisionally; no item is promoted to final catalogue without manual period and object verification.
Image URLs are extracted from cached product HTML as CDN originals with width/height/crop parameters removed; no image files were downloaded in this source-first pass.

next_checkpoint: Begin manual period/category/object review from the 363 canonical candidates; prioritize Ottoman medal/order records, then resolve modern Turkey and ambiguous records. Bind image files only after selected object verification.
